title: Set and reset
brief: A pin connected to nothing floats: it reads whatever noise is near it. A pull-up (10 kΩ to +) holds it HIGH, and a button to ground can still pull it LOW.
SET: pin 2 (TRIGGER) gets a pull-up and a button to ground. RESET: pin 4 gets the same. Pin 6 stays on −.
Power up and try it: SET lights the LED and it stays lit after you let go. RESET turns it off.
lesson: That's one bit of memory: the chip remembers which button was pressed last. Computers are built from enormous numbers of switches doing this.
